name: CoorAngle
comment: Returns vertices of an angle section, not an angle in degrees and not an I section. Argument order is h, b, tf, tw, then optional isRepeatFirstPoint. h is the vertical leg length, b the outstanding leg length, tf the outstanding-leg thickness, and tw the vertical-leg thickness. The heel is at the origin, the vertical leg lies on x = 0, and the outstanding leg runs along the top to x = b. Vertex order starts at the top of the heel and runs around the profile. isRepeatFirstPoint defaults to FALSE; TRUE appends the first vertex again. Non-numeric sizes return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
